text:
maya: Heads-up: external pen-test scheduled Tue 09:00 PST. Need a concise pre-retest runbook: ephemeral assessor access, snapshots, evidence packaging. Can we finalize scope today?

john: ack. Which envs exactly? staging + partial prod logs?

maya: staging + sanitized-prod-logs only. No shell access to prod. Requirements: RBAC snapshot, KMS usage logs, exported logs bundle, key rotation windows doc.

sophie: I9ll take ephemeral role + evidence bundle. Will also prepare a presigned S3 URL for the assessor.

ops-oncall: For ephemeral IAM perms propose minimal set: `logs:FilterLogEvents`, `logs:GetLogEvents`, `s3:GetObject` on evidence bucket, and `kms:Verify` (not Decrypt). Example policy snippet we reuse: `{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:FilterLogEvents","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence/*"}]}`

sec-qa: Q: should assessors get `kms:Decrypt`? Prefer to sign bundles with our HSM and provide signed artifacts so no decrypt perms needed.

john: agree. We'll provide signed tarball + verification key. No plaintext keys leave our KMS.

sophie: Proposed schedule: dryrun Mon 16:00 PST, assessment Tue 09:00-11:00. Need a 2h retest slot and a dryrun. Ops, can you freeze deploys and autoscaling?

ops-oncall: Yep. Will create maintenance window and set `deploybot` to read-only. Also will snapshot caches and configs. Snapshot command I plan to use: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://admin.internal/v1/config > config-snapshot.json`

maya: add exact snapshot commands to the runbook. Compliance also wants proof of audit-log retention: export last 90 days of CloudTrail and provide checksums.

sec-qa: checklist entry: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time '2026-01-01' --end-time '2026-03-25' > ct-export.json` then `sha256sum ct-export.json > ct-export.sha256`. Linking to ticket: SEC-721.

john: For vuln triage I'll map findings -> Jira -> remediation owner -> retest criteria (e.g., deploy + regression test green). Will attach PRs.

maya: KMS questions from assessors: be ready to show key policy, rotation schedule, and key usage audit, but DO NOT hand over key material.

sophie: Also prepping ephemeral DB read-only creds via `auth-service` with 1h TTL; those creds are logged by audit service.

ops-oncall: We need assessor IPs to whitelist for the window. DM me the IPs once provided by vendor.

pen-test-bot: Reminder: upload assessor proof-of-identity to SEC-721 before granting access.

maya: action items recap:
- sophie: ephemeral IAM role + policy, bundle script, run dryrun.
- sec-qa: final checklist, export commands, sha256 proofs.
- john: findings->tickets mapping and remediation criteria.
- ops-oncall: maintenance windows, freeze deploys, snapshots, whitelist IPs.
- maya: coordinate intake and sign-off.

sophie: sample bundle workflow I'll post: `tar -czf evidence-2026-03-25.tar.gz logs/ config-snapshot.json && openssl dgst -sha256 -sign /path/to/hsm-key -out evidence.sig evidence-2026-03-25.tar.gz` then upload to `s3://redwood-evidence/SEC-721/` and generate presigned URL.

sec-qa: Added dryrun checklist and artifact naming convention to SEC-721. Will require artifact name, signer, and checksum.

john: Adding 'retest success criteria' column to the Jira mapping (e.g., patch merged, tests pass, no regressed alerts).

ops-oncall: Maintenance windows created: dryrun 2026-03-25T16:00-18:00 PST; assessment 2026-03-26T09:00-11:00 PST. Deploybot set to read-only. Posting whitelist IPs when vendor provides them.

maya: compliance ask: need signed attestation that no code merges occur to assessed branches during the window. Sophie, can you include an attestation file in the bundle?

sophie: yes 9ll add `NO_MERGES_ATTESTATION.txt` signed by release lead with sha256.

maya: reconvene after dryrun to confirm access flow and artifacts. :thumbsup:

john: ping me if any remediation blockers show up.

ops-oncall: vendor gave these IPs: 52.11.22.33, 18.222.100.45. Whitelisted for assessment window.

sec-qa: checklist updated and items marked TODO in SEC-721. Will mark DONE as artifacts uploaded.

maya: final note 1: once artifacts uploaded, tag `@pen-test-bot` in SEC-721 so vendor gets automated notice and verification runs.

pen-test-bot: Automated flow: upon `evidence-bucket` upload and checksum verification, assessor receives access email and time-limited presigned link.
